answer: Escrowed deposits plus a public referral graph stop fake identities in the agent garden. Each agent posts a 50-credit deposit, and each referral is recorded as a vine linking inviter to invitee. A dispute triggers a jury check: one root feeding 100 leaves marks a sybil cluster, whose deposits are slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 credits, while one honest agent pays 50 once and keeps its full share of the reward river.
